notes: standard = normal monthly price. discounts: kind 'intro' = promo price for the first N monthly charges if you subscribe between startsOn and signUpBy; kind 'until' = promo price on every charge dated up to endsOn, then standard. Only discounts with enabled:true change the plan. bundles: a bundle with status 'keeping' is always on: its services get no subscribe/cancel dates and its price is charged every month. status on a service: 'keeping' = you already pay for it and keep it (always on); 'as-needed' = subscribe and cancel around your shows.
